freeze_boundary: Frozen before the first CUT-01 or TRIM-01 live episode. No result-based threshold changes under this protocol.
frames: Particles sampled in WORKPIECE LOCAL; recorded evaluator positions/reference_positions are WORLD; poses XYZ+XYZW; target plane belongs to workpiece

CUT-01.reason: Two main physical pieces each contain at least40% and together99% of initial mass; the conservative 4mm reference support permits midpoint spread below2mm around the intended plane. At most1% minor debris is allowed and separately counted.

TRIM-01.reason: Reference particle-centre region mass removal is scored separately from actual substrate triangle measurements, retaining the pre-existing1mm peak and0.5mm area error goals. Missing rays and tails are not discarded.

promotion_boundary: Task oracle metrics alone never certify actual robot execution, native cameras, complete simulation, calibrated fracture, or policy performance; existing D0 physics/defaults remain unchanged
